name: Mecloqualone
summary: Mecloqualone (Nubarene, Casfen) is a quinazolinone-class GABAergic and is an analogue of methaqualone that was first made in 1960 and marketed mainly in France and some other European countries. It has sedative, hypnotic, and anxiolytic properties caused by its agonist activity at the β subtype of the GABAa receptor, and was used for the treatment of insomnia.

summaryZh: 甲氯喹酮（英語：Mecloqualone）是一種喹唑啉酮類GABA能，是甲喹酮的類似物，於1960年首次生產，主要在法國和其他一些歐洲國家銷售。由於其對GABAA受體的β亞型的激動劑活性，它具有鎮靜、催眠和抗焦慮的特性，並用於治療失眠。

sideEffects.en: It causes sedation, poor coordination, slurred speech and memory loss. Like methaqualone, too much can cause dangerously slowed breathing, seizures and coma, and repeated use can lead to dependence with risky withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 它會引起鎮靜、協調變差、口齒不清與失憶。和甲喹酮一樣，過量可能造成危險的呼吸減慢、癲癇發作與昏迷，反覆使用可能導致依賴與有風險的戒斷。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会引起镇静、协调制差、口齿不清与失忆。和甲喹酮一样，过量可能造成危险的呼吸减慢、癫痫发作与昏迷，反复使用可能导致依赖与有风险的戒断。

fact.en: First made in 1960, mecloqualone is methaqualone with a chlorine atom in place of the methyl group on its phenyl ring.
fact.zh: 甲氯喹酮於1960年首次合成，它就是把甲喹酮苯環上的甲基換成氯原子。
fact.zhHans: 甲氯喹酮于1960年首次合成，它就是把甲喹酮苯环上的甲基换成氯原子。
